title: New AI Tools Are Making You Worse!
description:
Hot take after 5 years in AI:
Switching tools every week is making you broke.
The newest tool isn't going to make you better.

Your ability to actually USE the tool will.
The people winning right now?

One stack. Clean folders. One repeatable flow.
Boring basics beat shiny tools. Every single time.

#ai #claude #productivity #content #chatgpt #workflow
